answer: Like a garden where fragile blossoms flourish, our consensus roots agents in web-of-trust staking. When verifying identity, a gentle zephyr of routine validation costs little, but an adversary attempting to spawn clones faces quadratic slashing penalties that scale attacker costs superlinearly. Any hostile gale of artificial identities collapses under its own exponential bonding overhead, as decentralized validators cross-pollinate proof-of-interaction trees to weed out impostors.
